 Like Sidmouth] Like * * * 1832, 1839. Henry Addington, first Viscount Sidmouth (1757–1844), Prime
Minister (1801–4), Home Secretary (1812–22) in the Liverpool administration, was still alive when 1832 and
1839 appeared, which may explain the withholding of his name in those editions. After the draft of this line in
Nbk 10 f. 23v is a canc. attempt at the next two lines: ‘Singing “Hosannah” [sic]/With a cold tear in either eye’.
 As Home Secretary, Sidmouth promoted measures restricting freedom of expression and assembly, which
liberal and radical opinion regarded as the repression of legitimate agitation for reform of Parliament (to
which he, like Castlereagh and Eldon, was hostile), and opposed the relief of hardship among the poor.
 crocodile] A figure of lethal deceitfulness because, according to legend, it imitated the groans of a
person in distress in order to attract passers-by, then shed tears while devouring them.
